senses.gloss: (sub. mons) the Palatine Hill, a name given to royal residences in general (v. Dio Cassius LIII, 16); esp. Palatinus, a name given by the Samaritans to Mount Gerizim.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 32">Gen. R. s. 32</cite> <he>עבר בהדין פלטאנוס</he> (Var. <he>ניס …</he>, <he>נים …</he>; corr. acc.) passed that Palatinus (on his way to Jerusalem); <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 32">ib.</cite> s. 81 <cite ref="Q01024"><he>פלטנוס</he></cite> (not <he>ת …</he>); <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4">Cant. R. to IV, 4</cite> <he>חד פלאטנוס</he> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 57:2">Yalk. Gen. 57</cite> <he>פלטניס</he> (corr. acc.); (<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 3:6">Deut. R. s. 3</cite> <he>הר גריזים</he>).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 1:11">Num. R. s. 1</cite> <he>שבטו של לוי פ׳ היו</he> the tribe of Levi was the palace-guard (royal body-guard in the Temple).

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 5:9">Num. R. s. 5</cite> <he>אע״פ שהיתה משפחת קהת פ׳ וכ׳</he> although the Kehath family vere palatini, when carrying the Ark they carried it like slaves (on their shoulders, no rank being recognized before God, v. <cite ref="Q01019"><he>פַּלָּטִין</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 2:5">Ruth R. to I, 2</cite> (expl. <he>אפרתים</he>, <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 2:5">ib.</cite>) <cite ref="Q01017"><he>פלטייאני</he></cite> (corr. acc.); Midr. Sam. ch. I <cite ref="Q00930"><he>פלאטוני</he></cite> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 2:12">Lev. R. s. 2</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="A02821"><he>אפרים</he></cite>, <cite ref="Jeremiah 31:19">Jer. XXXI, 19</cite>) <cite ref="Q01013"><he>פלטיאני</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
Pirké d’R. El. ch. XLV (ref. to אפרת I Chr. II, 19) פלטיני בת מלכים וכ׳ (παλατίνη) a palatina, a daughter of nobles; ib. בן פלטוני בן מלכים וכ׳ (corr. acc.) a son of noblemen, a son of kings &c.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13:20">Num. R. s. 13</cite> <he>בן פלוטומנין</he>, <he>פולוט׳</he>; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 7:1">Pesik. R. s. 7</cite> <he>פולטומין</he> (corr. acc.).
